Suppose their joint law νr gives full measure to a Borel admissible domain Θr ⊂ [−Rr, Rr]a, is absolutely continuous with respect to Lebesgue measure, and satisfies 1 ≤ Rr ≤ eo(r) , dνr dθ ≤ eo(r) almost everywhere. There is a starting point xr ∈ Sr such that the successful parameter set Er = {θ ∈ Θr : xrv1,r(θ1) · · · vj,r(θj) ∈ Sr for every 1 ≤ j ≤ h} satisfies |Er| ≥ e−o(r) , |Φr(Er)|in ≥ e−o(r) .
